sentences.zh: 我是说，当时到底怎么回事？

sentences.en: Well, this whole Mentor Webisode did remind me of a letter that we got from Katie M.
sentences.zh: 嗯，整个导师网络剧系列让我想起了凯蒂·M寄来的一封信，

sentences.en: in Richmond,
sentences.zh: 她来自弗吉尼亚州里士满，

sentences.zh: 我想读一下，因为信里提到了女性在职场中互助的话题。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Because that's what this is.
sentences.zh: 因为这正是我们现在所做的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Angela's helping another woman in business.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉正在帮助另一位职场女性。

sentences.en: Katie said, I've been working at my company for five years and roughly two years in,
sentences.zh: 凯蒂说，我在现在的公司工作五年了，大约在两年前，

sentences.en: I started working with a young woman who was about five years older than me.
sentences.zh: 我开始和一位比我大五岁左右的年轻女性共事。

sentences.en: And she very quickly became my work BFF.
sentences.zh: 她很快就成了我的职场闺蜜。

sentences.en: We tackled many projects together and also made it through some rough times from sexist
sentences.zh: 我们一起共事过许多项目，也共同经历过一些艰难时刻，从性别歧视的

sentences.en: co-workers to surviving a series of layoffs.
sentences.zh: 同事到熬过一系列裁员。

sentences.en: After a big restructuring, she ended up being on another team.
sentences.zh: 在一次大规模重组后，她被调到了另一个团队。

sentences.en: And while we knew we wouldn't be able to work together as much, we still made an effort to
sentences.zh: 虽然我们知道以后不能像以前那样经常共事了，但我们还是努力

sentences.en: have a long chat at least once a month.
sentences.zh: 保持每个月至少长谈一次。

sentences.en: It was through these chats that we began talking seriously about career trajectories, and she
sentences.zh: 正是通过这些谈话，我们开始认真探讨职业发展轨迹，她

sentences.en: inspired me into taking on more serious projects on my team and advocating for myself.
sentences.zh: 激励我在团队中承担更重要的项目，并学会为自己争取权益。

sentences.en: At the end of last year, a position opened up on her new team, and she went above and beyond in
sentences.zh: 去年年底，她所在的团队出现了一个职位空缺，她不遗余力地

sentences.en: helping me prepare for interviews, market myself, and boost my confidence.
sentences.zh: 帮我准备面试、推销自己，并增强我的自信心。

sentences.en: Because of her, I ended up getting a serious promotion.
sentences.zh: 多亏了她，我最终获得了一次重要的晋升。

sentences.en: And I am now directly in the field I want to be.
sentences.zh: 现在我终于进入了自己心仪的领域。

sentences.en: Because of her, for the first time in my professional career, I am on an incredible team of all women.
sentences.zh: 多亏了她，我的职业生涯中第一次加入了一个全由女性组成的优秀团队。

sentences.en: Let's break the narrative of women kicking the ladder down and promote stories like mine of women lifting each other up.
sentences.zh: 让我们打破“女性拆台”的刻板印象，多宣传像我这样女性互相扶持的故事吧。

sentences.en: Aw, that's great.
sentences.zh: 噢，太棒了。

sentences.en: I loved that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个故事。

sentences.en: Thank you, Katie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，凯蒂。

sentences.en: And you know who it made me think of was Terri Weinberg.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，这让我想起了泰瑞·温伯格。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 噢，是的。

sentences.en: Terri Weinberg was one of the executive producers on The Office.
sentences.zh: 泰瑞·温伯格是《办公室》的执行制片人之一。

sentences.en: She worked for Reveille, which was the company that owned the rights to the British office.
sentences.zh: 她当时效力于Reveille公司，该公司拥有英版《办公室》的版权。

sentences.en: And they were part of developing the show for an American audience from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，他们就参与了美版剧集的开发工作。

sentences.en: Terri was part of our auditions.
sentences.zh: 泰瑞参与了我们的试镜。

sentences.en: She was on the set of the pilot.
sentences.zh: 她就在试播集的片场。

sentences.en: She is just an amazing woman.
sentences.zh: 她真是一位了不起的女性。

sentences.en: And after The Office was over, and I wanted to maybe get into some producing myself,
sentences.zh: 《办公室》结束后，我想尝试自己做制片人，

sentences.en: I had gotten a script, and I didn't know where to start.
sentences.zh: 我当时拿到一个剧本，却不知道从何下手。

sentences.en: I really liked it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢它。

sentences.en: It was from a writer submitted it to me.
sentences.zh: 是一位编剧投给我的。

sentences.en: And I thought, how do I get this into the hands of the studios?
sentences.zh: 我在想，我该怎么把它送到制片厂手里呢？

sentences.en: Like, how do I try to sell this?
sentences.zh: 比如，我该怎么尝试把它卖出去？

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: And I called Terri.
sentences.zh: 于是我给泰瑞打了电话。

sentences.en: And Terri said, send it to me.
sentences.zh: 泰瑞说，发给我吧。

sentences.en: I'll read it.
sentences.zh: 我会看的。

sentences.en: Let's have lunch.
sentences.zh: 我们一起吃个午饭吧。

sentences.en: I mean, do you know how much—she's so busy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道她有多忙吗？

sentences.en: And like, she took the time to read this thing that I thought maybe I could do something with.
sentences.zh: 她竟然抽出时间来读这个我以为或许能做点什么的东西。

sentences.en: She had lunch with me.
sentences.zh: 她和我一起吃了午饭。

sentences.en: She gave me all her thoughts.
sentences.zh: 她给了我她所有的想法。

sentences.en: She laid out, like, here's what I would do.
sentences.zh: 她给我列出了建议，比如，我会怎么做。

sentences.en: Here's what I wouldn't do.
sentences.zh: 我不会怎么做。

sentences.en: And I ended up selling it to Warner Brothers.
sentences.zh: 最后我把它卖给了华纳兄弟。

sentences.en: Now, the show didn't get made, but under Terri's guidance, like—and she said,
sentences.zh: 虽然那部剧后来没拍成，但在泰瑞的指导下——她说，

sentences.en: always call me about stuff like this, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，以后有这种事随时打给我。

sentences.en: Always.
sentences.zh: 随时。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: This is what I do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的工作。

sentences.en: Like, this is what I love doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是我热爱的事业。

sentences.en: I love helping other women in this industry make their mark.
sentences.zh: 我热爱帮助这个行业里的其他女性留下她们的印记。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah, she has been incredibly supportive to us over all these years, is still in touch with us,
sentences.zh: 没错，这些年来她一直非常支持我们，至今仍与我们保持联系，

sentences.en: is still such a huge champion.
sentences.zh: 依然是我们坚定的支持者。

sentences.en: Whatever marker happens in our career, she celebrates it.
sentences.zh: 无论我们的职业生涯有什么里程碑，她都会为我们庆祝。

sentences.en: When we wrote our book, when we got the podcast, just on and on.
sentences.zh: 我们写书时、做播客时，诸如此类，不胜枚举。

sentences.en: I'm sure if you look in our comments on Instagram, you're going to see cheerleading from Terri
sentences.zh: 我相信如果你去翻我们的 Instagram 评论区，一定会看到 Terri

sentences.zh: 在我们帖子下的加油打气。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 她真是太棒了。

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.zh: 好了，听着，网络系列节目到这里就结束了。

sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.zh: 观看这个系列真是种享受。

sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: It was really fun.
sentences.zh: 真的很有趣。

sentences.en: But before we go, we wanted to share a few more of your stories of mentorship and our own.
sentences.zh: 但在结束之前，我们想再分享几个你们关于导师的故事，以及我们自己的故事。

sentences.en: I'm going to kick us off with a letter that I just loved.
sentences.zh: 我先来读一封我特别喜欢的信。

sentences.en: It's from Kristen from Virginia.
sentences.zh: 这封信来自弗吉尼亚州的 Kristen。

sentences.en: And Kristen says,
sentences.zh: Kristen 说，

sentences.en: When I was in my mid-twenties, I became infatuated with calligraphy.
sentences.zh: 我二十多岁时迷上了书法。

sentences.en: I received a gift certificate to take classes with a local woman named Betsy.
sentences.zh: 我收到了一张礼券，可以去上一位当地女士 Betsy 的课。

sentences.en: She was probably in her 70s and was left-handed, which is a challenge for calligraphers.
sentences.zh: 她当时大概 70 多岁，是左撇子，这对书法家来说是个挑战。

sentences.en: So she wrote upside down.
sentences.zh: 所以她是倒着写的。

sentences.en: It was incredible to watch.
sentences.zh: 看她写字真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: She was so thrilled someone under the age of 50 actually wanted to learn calligraphy.
sentences.zh: 她非常激动，因为终于有个 50 岁以下的人想学书法了。

sentences.en: I was hooked on the art for my very first class with her.
sentences.zh: 从第一节课开始，我就彻底迷上了这门艺术。

sentences.en: I signed up for every class she offered and eventually asked her to be my mentor.
sentences.zh: 我报名了她开设的所有课程，最终还请她担任我的导师。

sentences.en: I started taking private lessons, and she exposed me to so much about the art,
sentences.zh: 我开始上私教课，她让我接触到了这门艺术的方方面面，

sentences.en: different tools and supplies, lettering styles, artists, historical references, and so much more.
sentences.zh: 不同的工具和用品、字体风格、艺术家、历史参考资料等等，不胜枚举。

sentences.en: I learned something new every week, and it really put me ahead
sentences.zh: 我每周都能学到新东西，这真的让我在后来

sentences.en: when I started engaging in professional work and networking.
sentences.zh: 开始从事专业工作和建立人脉时领先了一步。

sentences.en: Because of her, I started a business, wrote a book, started teaching,
sentences.zh: 因为她，我创办了公司，写了书，开始教学，

sentences.en: and became very involved with a professional calligraphy organization,
sentences.zh: 并积极参与了一个专业的书法组织，

sentences.en: of which I am currently the president.
sentences.zh: 我现在还是该组织的会长。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: In 2020, Betsy was diagnosed with advanced ALS and was unable to continue working.
sentences.zh: 2020 年，Betsy 被诊断出患有晚期渐冻症（ALS），无法继续工作。

sentences.en: Shortly before she passed away, she referred a few jobs to me and told me that I was one of her
sentences.zh: 在她去世前不久，她给我介绍了几份工作，并告诉我我是她

sentences.en: best students.
sentences.zh: 最好的学生之一。

sentences.en: And Kristen put in parentheses, crying.
sentences.zh: Kristen 在括号里写道：正在哭泣。

sentences.en: I am crying.
sentences.zh: 我也在哭。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Chills.
sentences.zh: 起鸡皮疙瘩了。

sentences.en: She goes on to say she wished me the best of luck with the calligraphy community.
sentences.zh: 她接着说，祝我在书法界一切顺利。

sentences.en: This year, I got to host a calligraphy conference in the very city she taught me in,
sentences.zh: 今年，我有幸在她当年教我的城市举办了一场书法大会，

sentences.en: and it's a really beautiful, full-circle moment for me.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这真是一个圆满而美好的时刻。

sentences.en: I wouldn't be where I am today without Betsy.
sentences.zh: 没有 Betsy，就不会有今天的我。

sentences.en: I think of Betsy often and how selfless she was.
sentences.zh: 我经常想起 Betsy，想起她有多么无私。

sentences.en: She had no secrets.
sentences.zh: 她毫无保留。

sentences.en: She just wanted to pass along her knowledge.
sentences.zh: 她只是想把自己的知识传授下去。

sentences.en: The style she taught me, called Copper Plate, is actually a style she didn't love love,
sentences.zh: 她教我的那种风格叫铜版体，其实她本人并不是特别喜欢，

sentences.en: but she taught it in memory of a dear friend of hers that passed away.
sentences.zh: 但她教这个是为了纪念她一位已故的挚友。

sentences.en: The mindset of generosity and legacy is something I carry with me daily.
sentences.zh: 那种慷慨和传承的精神，我每天都铭记在心。

sentences.en: That's making me tear up.
sentences.zh: 这让我都要掉眼泪了。

sentences.en: Yeah, me too.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我也是。

sentences.en: Betsy was and continues to be an inspiration to me, and I'm so lucky I had the chance to
sentences.zh: 贝齐过去是，现在依然是我灵感的源泉，我真的很幸运能有机会

sentences.en: learn from her.
sentences.zh: 向她学习。

sentences.en: Thanks for the opportunity to share about this mentorship experience that means so much
sentences.zh: 感谢你们给我这个机会，让我分享这段对我意义重大的

sentences.en: to me.
sentences.zh: 导师经历。

sentences.en: I just love that legacy that Betsy has that she passed down.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢贝齐留下的那种传承，她把它传给了后人。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢你。

sentences.en: She changed that woman's life, truly.
sentences.zh: 她真的改变了那个女人的生活。

sentences.en: Truly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's become her whole career now.
sentences.zh: 这现在已经成了她毕生的事业。

sentences.en: It just took such time to share her knowledge and didn't hold any of it back, gave it all
sentences.zh: 她花了很多时间去分享自己的知识，毫无保留，倾囊相授，

sentences.en: freely to her, to share with her, to build her up.
sentences.zh: 为了分享，为了成就她。

sentences.en: Kristen, thank you so much for sharing.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀，非常感谢你的分享。

sentences.en: That letter really touched us, and we're so happy now to know about Betsy.
sentences.zh: 那封信真的触动了我们，我们现在很高兴能认识贝齐。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 指导过我们的人。

sentences.zh: 你知道，我立刻就知道我要分享谁了，那就是我的祖母，

sentences.en: Lena May Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 莉娜·梅·金西。

sentences.en: So much of who I am, of my values, of the things that I connect with that mean something
sentences.zh: 我之所以成为现在的我，我的价值观，以及我所珍视的那些事物，

sentences.en: to me, they all started with her.
sentences.zh: 这一切都源于她。

sentences.en: I've shared this before.
sentences.zh: 我以前也分享过。

sentences.en: I moved around a lot as a kid, just with my dad's job, but my grandmother's home was
sentences.zh: 小时候因为父亲工作的关系，我经常搬家，但祖母的家

sentences.en: the one constant place I had.
sentences.zh: 是我唯一不变的港湾。

sentences.en: And I would go and stay with her in the summers, and looking back on that time, oh my gosh, I
sentences.zh: 夏天我会去她那里住，回想起那段时光，天哪，我

sentences.en: just cherish it.
sentences.zh: 真的非常珍惜。

sentences.en: She just taught me so many things.
sentences.zh: 她教会了我很多东西。

sentences.en: I mean, I started to list them out in no particular order.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我开始列举它们，不分先后。

sentences.en: She taught me how to work a riding lawnmower.
sentences.zh: 她教我怎么开乘坐式割草机。

sentences.en: She taught me how to drive a car.
sentences.zh: 她教我怎么开车。

sentences.en: She taught me how to crochet.
sentences.zh: 她教我怎么钩针编织。

sentences.en: She tried to teach me how to quilt.
sentences.zh: 她试着教我怎么做拼布被。

sentences.en: I was just not very patient.
sentences.zh: 我当时没什么耐心。

sentences.en: She was an amazing quilter.
sentences.zh: 她是一位了不起的拼布高手。

sentences.en: She would put us all to work, all of her grandkids in her garden.
sentences.zh: 她会让我们所有孙辈都在她的花园里干活。

sentences.en: The woman could grow anything.
sentences.zh: 那个女人什么都能种出来。

sentences.en: And I would spend hours with her in her kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我会在她的厨房里陪她待上好几个小时。

sentences.en: She always had something from her garden that she was making or our chores that she would
sentences.zh: 她总是会用花园里的食材做些什么，或者安排我们

sentences.en: have us do.
sentences.zh: 做些家务。

sentences.en: And it's so interesting because, you know, your parents might give you a chore, and you're
sentences.zh: 很有意思的是，你知道，父母让你做家务时，你可能会

sentences.en: like, ugh.
sentences.zh: 觉得很烦。

sentences.en: But my grandmother would give me a chore, and I delighted in it.
sentences.zh: 但祖母让我做家务时，我却乐在其中。

sentences.en: I was like, what can I do?
sentences.zh: 我当时会问，我能帮什么忙？

sentences.en: One time, she taught me how to make homemade ice cream using the peaches that she had picked
sentences.zh: 有一次，她教我怎么用她亲手采摘的桃子制作自制冰淇淋，

sentences.en: from her garden.
sentences.zh: 那些桃子就来自她的花园。

sentences.en: And, you know, in sort of going back and remembering, I have this book that she made me, and I started
sentences.zh: 你知道，在回首往事时，我翻开了她为我制作的那本书，并开始

sentences.en: to go through it.
sentences.zh: 仔细阅读。

sentences.en: I had saved all of her cards and letters.
sentences.zh: 我保存了她写给我的所有卡片和信件。

sentences.en: She was a very big believer in writing letters and cards.
sentences.zh: 她非常笃信写信和寄卡片的意义。

sentences.en: You got a card every year on your birthday to all of her grandkids.
sentences.zh: 她所有的孙辈每年生日都能收到她寄来的卡片。

sentences.en: She had a ton, and her great-grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 她有很多孙辈，还有曾孙辈。

sentences.en: But she also wrote me a lot of letters.
sentences.zh: 但她也给我写过很多信。

sentences.en: She put together this whole book for me when I asked her one time, once, I said, I would
sentences.zh: 有一次我随口提了一句，说我想

sentences.en: love to know more about our family tree.
sentences.zh: 多了解一下我们的家族树，她就为我整理了整整一本书。

sentences.en: She put together a whole book for me of birth certificates and marriage license and just on
sentences.zh: 她把出生证明、结婚证书以及关于我们家族历史的各种资料，

sentences.en: and on about our family history.
sentences.zh: 统统整理成册交给了我。

sentences.en: Jenna, here's a picture of all her peaches.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，这是她种的那些桃子的照片。

sentences.en: She would just send me pictures from her yard.
sentences.zh: 她经常会给我发她院子里的照片。

sentences.en: And these are the things that just mean so much to me that I still find ground me in my life now.
sentences.zh: 这些对我来说意义非凡，至今仍是我生活中的精神支柱。

sentences.en: She had a real heart for service.
sentences.zh: 她拥有一颗热衷于服务他人的心。

sentences.en: She volunteered in her community.
sentences.zh: 她经常在社区做志愿者。

sentences.en: She was a firm believer in, if you don't have something nice to say, then don't say anything at all.
sentences.zh: 她坚信，如果你说不出什么好话，那就什么都别说。

sentences.en: And I have these tangible mementos of her now.
sentences.zh: 现在，我拥有这些关于她的珍贵纪念品。

sentences.en: She made us all quilts by hand.
sentences.zh: 她亲手为我们每个人缝制了被子。

sentences.en: She made each of her grandkids a little lacy cover for their baby Bible.
sentences.zh: 她还为每个孙辈的婴儿圣经缝制了蕾丝封套。

sentences.en: But I look now in my own home, and I see all of these touchstones that are her.
sentences.zh: 现在环顾我的家，我能看到所有这些属于她的印记。

sentences.en: If you went in her house, she had so many pictures.
sentences.zh: 如果你去过她家，会发现她摆放了特别多的照片。

sentences.en: Like, it almost looked cluttered because she just wanted everyone to see her family.
sentences.zh: 看起来甚至有点杂乱，因为她就是想让每个人都能看到她的家人。

sentences.en: And my house is so full of pictures.
sentences.zh: 而我的家里也摆满了照片。

sentences.en: I once had a friend who was dating this new gal, and she was very chic.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我有个朋友带新女友来家里，那女孩非常时髦。

sentences.en: And she came over to my house, and she walked in, and she goes,
sentences.zh: 她走进我家，然后说，

sentences.en: Oh, she goes, I feel like I'm in a grandma's house.
sentences.zh: “噢，”她说，“感觉就像进了奶奶家一样。”

sentences.en: And I think she meant it to be snarky.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她这话带点讽刺意味。

sentences.en: But I took it as such a compliment.
sentences.zh: 但我却把它当作一种赞美。

sentences.en: I mean, my kitchen cabinets, I purposely picked the color that was my grandmother's wallpaper in her kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我厨房橱柜的颜色，就是特意选的和我祖母厨房壁纸一样的颜色。

sentences.en: Anyway, she was just full of grace and kindness.
sentences.zh: 总之，她充满了优雅与善良。

sentences.en: She was hardworking and earneSt.
sentences.zh: 她勤劳而真诚。

sentences.en: I just loved and admired her.
sentences.zh: 我深爱并敬仰着她。

sentences.en: And as I went back through her letters and cards that she sent me over the years that I saved,
sentences.zh: 当我翻看这些年来她寄给我并被我珍藏的信件和卡片时，

sentences.en: I wanted to share just one sentence that she wrote to me.
sentences.zh: 我想分享她写给我的一句话。

sentences.en: And it just kind of sums everything up.
sentences.zh: 这句话简直概括了一切。

sentences.en: She had written me a card because I had just moved to Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 当时我刚搬到洛杉矶，她给我寄了一张卡片。

sentences.en: And I had shared with her that I was really struggling on how to start this dream of being an actor.
sentences.zh: 我曾向她倾诉，说我对于如何开启演员梦想感到非常迷茫。

sentences.en: No one in my family was an actor.
sentences.zh: 我们家里没人做过演员。

sentences.en: This was a crazy thing for me to go to Los Angeles and do this.
sentences.zh: 去洛杉矶闯荡对我来说是一件疯狂的事。

sentences.en: And the first sentence of her card she sent me said this,
sentences.zh: 而她寄给我的那张卡片，第一句话就是这样写的：

sentences.en: I believe you are on your way.
sentences.zh: “我相信你正在通往成功的路上。”

sentences.en: There may be bumps in the road, but that makes the smooth part seem much better.
sentences.zh: “路上或许会有坎坷，但正是因为有了这些，平坦的路才显得更加美好。”

sentences.en: So, she's one of my biggest mentors.
sentences.zh: 所以，她是我人生中最重要的导师之一。

sentences.en: And I, you know, my happy place is my yard with my plants and my hummingbirds.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我最快乐的地方就是我的院子，那里有我的花草和蜂鸟。

sentences.en: She had the most amazing hummingbird feeder.
sentences.zh: 她曾拥有一个最棒的蜂鸟喂食器。

sentences.en: It was just a regular one, but it hung outside her kitchen window.
sentences.zh: 那只是个普通的喂食器，但挂在她厨房窗外。

sentences.en: And she would get a gazillion hummingbirds.
sentences.zh: 总会有成千上万只蜂鸟飞来。

sentences.en: And we would just sit there and visit at her kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 我们就坐在她家的餐桌旁聊天。

sentences.en: And yeah, I'm so thankful that I had her in my life.
sentences.zh: 真的，我很庆幸生命中有她的存在。

sentences.en: Lady, I am so, like, moved by your description of her because
sentences.zh: 天哪，你对她的描述真的让我很感动，因为

sentences.en: everything you're saying, it is just living through you.
sentences.zh: 你所说的一切，仿佛就在你身上重现。

sentences.en: Like, so clearly to me as your friend.
sentences.zh: 作为你的朋友，我看得一清二楚。

sentences.en: Like, when you said that when you walked in her house, she had tons of pictures.
sentences.zh: 比如你说当你走进她家时，那里摆满了照片。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a thing about you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这和你很像。

sentences.en: Like, guys, Angela's fridge is covered.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，安吉拉的冰箱上贴满了照片。

sentences.en: You put pictures in frames.
sentences.zh: 你总是把照片装进相框里。

sentences.en: And I love how your home feels.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢你家给人的感觉。

sentences.en: But also, like, how many pictures of your hydrangea can you take?
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，你的绣球花到底能拍多少张照片啊？

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: And that's the picture of the peaches right there.
sentences.zh: 还有那张桃子的照片就在那儿。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你懂吗？

sentences.en: Like, she is living through you.
sentences.zh: 她仿佛就在你身上活着。

sentences.en: Like, this, I see her impact on you.
sentences.zh: 我能清楚地看到她对你的影响。

sentences.en: So clearly, as you described this, all the handwritten notes you've sent to me,
sentences.zh: 当你描述这一切时，我看得非常清楚，你发给我的所有手写便条，

sentences.en: all of your digital clutter, it's all, like, I'm just seeing her.
sentences.zh: 你所有的数字杂物，这一切，我仿佛都看到了她。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for sharing that.
sentences.zh: 噢，谢谢你的分享。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I feel like even after all these years, I just got to know you even more deeply
sentences.zh: 我觉得即使过了这么多年，因为你的分享，

sentences.en: because you shared that.
sentences.zh: 我反而更深入地了解你了。

sentences.en: Oh, you would have just loved her.
sentences.zh: 噢，你一定会很喜欢她的。

sentences.en: I have no doubt.
sentences.zh: 我对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你。

sentences.en: Well, Jenna, I know you have a letter that really moved you
sentences.zh: 那么，珍娜，我知道你有一封让你深受感动的信，

sentences.en: that was sent in to us that you would like to share.
sentences.zh: 那是寄给我们的，你想和大家分享一下。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想分享。

sentences.en: So this letter was from Omar R.
sentences.zh: 这封信来自布鲁克林威廉斯堡的奥马尔·R。

sentences.en: in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 这是奥马尔写的内容。

sentences.en: Here's what Omar said.
sentences.zh: 首先，我是从第一天就开始听节目的听众。

sentences.en: First of all, day one listener here.
sentences.zh: 你们的节目和播客给我带来了很多快乐。

sentences.en: Your show and podcast has brought me so much joy.
sentences.zh: 每当我感到焦虑时，听你们女士们聊天真的能让我放松下来，

sentences.en: And anytime I have anxiety, hearing you ladies talk really relaxes me
sentences.zh: 让我觉得一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: and makes me feel like everything will be okay.
sentences.zh: 我的导师故事很独特，因为我年轻时并不知道他们是我的导师。

sentences.en: My mentor story is unique in that I didn't know they were my mentors when I was younger.
sentences.zh: 我21岁时在布鲁克林的一家酒吧，两位年长的绅士坐在我旁边，

sentences.en: I was 21 years old at a bar in Brooklyn and two older gentlemen sat next to me
sentences.zh: 他们无意中听到我和朋友聊天，就跟我打了招呼。

sentences.en: and they overheard me talking to my friends and they said hi.
sentences.zh: 他们刚从法国搬到美国。

sentences.en: They had just moved to the United States from France.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了几乎一整晚，发现他们养了一只狗，

sentences.en: We ended up talking most of the night and found out they had a dog who needed walking
sentences.zh: 每隔一个月他们回法国出差时，就需要有人帮忙遛狗和照顾它。

sentences.en: and taking care of every other month when they were back in France for business.
sentences.zh: 他们教会了我所知道的一切礼仪。

sentences.en: They taught me everything I know about etiquette.
sentences.zh: 在我21岁时，他们带我参加了人生中第一次晚宴、活动和百老汇演出。

sentences.en: They brought me to my first ever dinner parties, events, Broadway shows at 21.
sentences.zh: 我当时不懂礼节，老实说，我也不太懂什么是尊重。

sentences.en: I didn't know about decorum and honestly, I didn't know very much about respect.
sentences.zh: 他们相信我，总是鼓励我努力工作，成就一番事业。

sentences.en: They believed in me and always encouraged me to work hard and make something with myself.
sentences.zh: 他们的善良和激励正是我这个迷茫的21岁青年所需要的。

sentences.en: Their kindness and motivation was what I needed as a lost 21-year-old.
sentences.zh: 我帮他们遛狗，帮他们看家，持续了好几年。

sentences.en: I walked their dog and sat there home for years.
sentences.zh: 几年前他们搬回了法国，我一直没能好好地感谢他们。

sentences.en: They moved back to France a few years ago and I never fully got to thank them
sentences.zh: 我一直没能好好地感谢他们。

sentences.en: for everything they taught me about life.
sentences.zh: 感谢他们教会我的一切人生道理。

sentences.en: So, say yes to those who are older and wiser.
sentences.zh: 所以，要对那些年长且睿智的人说“好”。

sentences.en: Say yes to those who motivate you to pursue your dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 要对那些激励你追求梦想的人说“好”。

sentences.en: Say yes to those who have positive intent for your life.
sentences.zh: 要对那些对你的人生怀有善意的人说“好”。

sentences.en: I now help run a creative department for a tech company,
sentences.zh: 我现在在一家科技公司负责一个创意部门，

sentences.en: a position I would have never had if they didn't always believe in me
sentences.zh: 如果不是他们始终相信我，

sentences.en: to pursue my dreams and never give up.
sentences.zh: 鼓励我追求梦想、永不放弃，我绝不可能得到这个职位。

sentences.en: And then Omar said,
sentences.zh: 然后奥马尔说，

sentences.en: Thank you, ladies, for all that you do.
sentences.zh: “谢谢你们，女士们，感谢你们所做的一切。”

sentences.en: Looking forward to hearing more and more stories y'all have to share.
sentences.zh: 期待听到你们分享更多更多的故事。

sentences.en: Also, finally watched The Edge because of your podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 另外，因为你们的播客，我终于看了《边缘》。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And I now say to my friends,
sentences.zh: 我现在也常对朋友们说，

sentences.en: a good plan today is better than a perfect plan tomorrow.
sentences.zh: “今天的一个好计划，胜过明天的完美计划。”

sentences.en: And I have now become a mentor to my younger friends.
sentences.zh: 我现在也成了年轻朋友们的导师。

sentences.en: And I owe it all to two random Frenchmen I met in a bar when I was 21.
sentences.zh: 这一切都要归功于我21岁时在酒吧遇到的两个素不相识的法国人。

sentences.en: I'm 31 now.
sentences.zh: 我现在31岁了。

sentences.en: Aww.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: I just loved it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个故事了。

sentences.en: I did too because it's the kindness and, you know, they were strangers.
sentences.zh: 我也很喜欢，因为这体现了善意，而且，你知道，他们当时只是陌生人。

sentences.en: They were kind.
sentences.zh: 他们很善良。

sentences.en: And they helped this young person, like, have a sense of security, community.
sentences.zh: 他们帮助了一个年轻人，让她感受到了一种安全感和归属感。

sentences.en: And that's a lifelong friendship.
sentences.zh: 那是一段终身的友谊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's wonderful.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, Jenna, I know you have a really special mentor you would like to share about.
sentences.zh: 那么，珍娜，我知道你有一位非常特别的导师想要分享。

sentences.en: I would.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想分享。

sentences.en: I want to share about my breast cancer mentor, Clea Shearer.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈我的乳腺癌导师，克莉亚·希勒。

sentences.en: In all of my talking about my journey so far, I haven't had a chance to share about Clea.
sentences.zh: 在我讲述自己这段经历的过程中，一直没机会提到克莉亚。

sentences.en: Maybe because.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为……

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's so emotional.
sentences.zh: 这太让人感伤了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But after I got my diagnosis, the only person I'd ever known who had had breast cancer was Christina Applegate.
sentences.zh: 但在我确诊后，我唯一认识的患过乳腺癌的人就是克里斯蒂娜·艾伯盖特。

sentences.en: We had done a movie together, Hall Pass.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起拍过一部电影，叫《放风通行证》。

sentences.en: It was after she had been through her surgery, and we shared a lot about it on that movie.
sentences.zh: 那时她刚做完手术，我们在拍戏期间交流了很多关于这方面的事。

sentences.en: She's such a wonderful person.
sentences.zh: 她真是个了不起的人。

sentences.en: And after I got my diagnosis, I texted Christina, and I said, hey, do you have a minute to talk?
sentences.zh: 在我确诊后，我给克里斯蒂娜发了条短信，问她：“嘿，你有空聊聊吗？”

sentences.en: And are you somewhere private?
sentences.zh: “你现在方便说话吗？”

sentences.en: I have something personal to share with you.
sentences.zh: “我有件私事想跟你说。”

sentences.en: She texted back, I'm alone.
sentences.zh: 她回信说：“我一个人，打给我吧。”

sentences.en: Call me.
